summary: Retest of responsiveness fixes (overflow-hidden on Solution/Showcase/Platform + body overflow-x hidden, and h-11 on nav-mobile-book-demo-button). All previously reported issues from iteration_3 are RESOLVED.
critical_code_review_comments: Solution.jsx 'Without Synqora' fragment cards lack data-testid attributes (mobile 2-col grid layout could not be programmatically asserted). Consider adding data-testid="without-synqora-fragment-N" for future regression testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsiveness fixes verified at 390x844, 768x1024, and 1440x900. scrollWidth == innerWidth on all three viewports both initially and after scrolling through all sections + interacting with mobile nav, role tabs, platform modules, and FAQ. Mobile Book Demo button is exactly 44px tall (meets 44 threshold). demo-modal opens on tap. No horizontal overflow persists after any interaction. Recharts width(-1) console warning remains (known/cosmetic, out of scope).
rca of the issue: N/A - previous overflow (394 at 390, 772 at 768) was resolved by adding overflow-hidden to #solution/#showcase/#platform sections plus body overflow-x:hidden, which now clips decorative blur divs. Tap target fix (h-9 -> h-11) confirmed.
